title: Garin acquitted of graft in Dengvaxia case

blocks.text: The Sandiganbayan Special Second Division acquitted House Deputy Speaker Janette Garin of graft and illegal use of public funds in relation to the purchase of the anti-dengue vaccine Dengvaxia when she served as health secretary.
